cloud_writes.what: creates the site (stays; the engine does not delete)
imports the 1 m DSM as map QA_<run>-1m (upload, MAP job, tiling)
imports the 28 m DSM as map QA_<run>-28 (upload, MAP job, tiling)
imports the 29 m DSM as map QA_<run>-29 (upload, MAP job, tiling)
creates the flight QA_<tablet> Spain terrain (left unsaved)

expected: In a new QA_ site at Spain (40.400000, -3.700000): Maps import accepts the synthetic UTM DSMs at 1 m (high resolution), 28 m and 29 m (low resolution) as DSM files and imports them as maps. In a new flight there, Add terrain / map > Use existing map lists all three after processing; QA_<run>-1m and QA_<run>-28 are selectable and QA_<run>-29 is listed but greyed out. Nothing is chosen and nothing in the planner is saved.

steps.read_js: (() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const row = n => { const el = [...d.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === n); let r = el; for (let i = 0; i < 5 && r; i++) { r = r.parentElement; const c = r && r.querySelector('input[type=checkbox], [role=checkbox], button'); if (c) return {found: true, disabled: !!(c.disabled || c.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || c.hasAttribute('data-disabled') || (c.closest('[aria-disabled=true]')))}; } return {found: !!el, disabled: null}; }; return {m1: row('QA_{run}-1m'), m28: row('QA_{run}-28'), m29: row('QA_{run}-29')}; })()
